title: Wendy and the Flower Without a Hat
synopsis: Wendy finds the first sunflower open, jokes with Ben about its size and leaves the flower to itself, taking her little paper hat home.
continuity_state: Before: The larger sunflower bud had shown its first pale yellow edge a few days earlier; its partner is still in a green closed bud. Wendy owns her blue-ribboned hat. After: The first sunflower is open with broad yellow petals and a dark center. The second sunflower remains budded. A single incidental bee visits and flies away; the children do not chase it. Wendy takes her little crooked-brimmed paper hat home to Far Meadow and puts it on a walnut-shaped wooden knob. Her straw hat retains its blue ribbon.

related_resources.reason: NYBG describes flowering after the longer growth period; an open bloom after preceding closed buds is botanically plausible.
